title: Pipeline State Object (PSO) creation hitch
fix_rationale: The trace shows pipeline state object (PSO) creation on the render/RHI thread at draw time. Enabling PSO precaching or bundling a recorded PSO cache resolves first-draw hitches.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms creating graphics or compute pipeline states on the {thread} thread ({share}% of excess time).

fixes.text: Enable PSO Precaching in Project Settings.
Record a PSO cache during a gameplay playthrough and bundle the compiled PSO cache into your game package.
Preload and pre-warm major gameplay visual effects and materials during level transitions.

verify: Re-test the exact trigger in a packaged build with bundled PSO cache and check that PSO creation times drop to 0 ms.
caveats: In the editor, PSO precaching behaves differently and shader caches are invalidated frequently.
